text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can generate art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. AI can copy styles and mix ideas, but it does not have feelings, personal experiences, or true imagination. Human artists create from emotion and life experience, which gives their work deep meaning. AI can be a helpful tool, but it cannot replace the human heart behind real creativity.
